title: Berry Snake
description: Steer the snake, eat strawberries and don't run into yourself. It speeds up as you grow.

title: Brick Patch
description: Bounce the ball off your paddle and clear every row of bricks. Five levels, three lives.

title: Chess Opus
description: Play chess online against friends with room codes, chat while you play, climb the Elo leaderboard and pick a board theme.

title: Pinewood Hotels
description: Work the night desk at a remote hotel in November 1999 and survive until morning. Low-poly 3D horror with voiced characters and 2-player co-op.
